Card Q&A.q: Can I choose to not delete any of my opponent's Digimon by not choosing them for this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

a: If this card's [When Attacking] effect activates, you must trash at least 1 card from digivolution cards.
However, if you choose to not activate this effect, it won't activate, and no digivolution cards will be trashed.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [When Attacking] effect, but then choose to not trash any cards in this card's digivolution cards?

a: No, the 2 Digimon or Tamers aren't deleted at the same time.
You repeat this card's [When Attacking] effect of deleting 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers with the lowest play cost for each card trashed from digivolution cards.

In this case, you trashed 2 digivolution cards, therefore you first delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers with the lowest play cost, then you again delete 1 of their Digimon or Tamers with the lowest play cost.
Card Q&A.q: If I trash 2 digivolution cards for this card's [When Attacking] effect, do I delete 2 of my opponent's Digimon or Tamers at the same time?

a: You repeat this card's [When Attacking] effect of deleting 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers with the lowest play cost for each card trashed from digivolution cards.
